mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy reduces corporate borrowing capacity and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), the Federal Reserve implements accommodative monetary policy to stimulate job growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market contraction regimes (HOUST < 650.0 thousand units), declining home construction reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).
